title: Check Malaysia's API, not AQI, for local air quality, says expert
summary: Clarifies the difference between Malaysia's official Air Pollutant Index, which draws on ground-level monitoring, and international air quality indices, and advises using official local readings for health decisions.

title: IPU Malaysia wajar jadi rujukan utama
summary: Membincangkan peranan bacaan rasmi Indeks Pencemar Udara Malaysia sebagai rujukan utama untuk keputusan kesihatan awam setempat.

title: Haze in Malaysia: Why burning leaves and rubbish in your compound is more dangerous than you think
summary: Examines how burning leaves and household waste in residential areas adds to air pollution during the haze season, and why composting and safer waste disposal are better alternatives.

title: Risiko jerebu teruk Julai hingga Oktober ini
summary: Meneliti risiko jerebu bermusim dan keadaan persekitaran yang berkaitan dengan tempoh kering.

title: Gas sulfur tinggi ancam kesihatan penduduk Asia Tenggara
summary: Menjelaskan implikasi alam sekitar dan kesihatan awam daripada pelepasan sulfur gunung berapi yang dibawa melalui atmosfera.

title: KL traffic jams can create heat bubbles, says expert
summary: Explores the relationship between traffic congestion, urban heat accumulation and air quality in Kuala Lumpur.

title: Peningkatan jumlah kenderaan menyumbang kepada fenomena pulau haba bandar
summary: Membincangkan perkaitan antara kepadatan kenderaan, fenomena pulau haba bandar dan keadaan alam sekitar.

title: Giatkan program Hari Tanpa Bahan Api dan Kenderaan demi kualiti udara terbaik
summary: Membincangkan inisiatif pengangkutan rendah pelepasan dan kaitannya dengan penambahbaikan kualiti udara semasa sekatan pergerakan berkaitan pandemik.

title: Mencari penyelesaian masalah jerebu
summary: Meneliti pendekatan yang mungkin untuk mengurangkan jerebu dan mengurus pembakaran sisa pertanian.

title: Pembakaran kecil boleh jejas kualiti udara
summary: Menjelaskan bagaimana pembakaran berskala kecil menjejaskan kualiti udara setempat, terutama apabila pergerakan udara lemah, dan mengapa sumber pencemaran tempatan tetap perlu dikawal.

title: Malaysia welcomes Indonesia's endorsement of Asean haze pact
summary: Reports Malaysia's welcome of Indonesia's ratification of the ASEAN Agreement on Transboundary Haze Pollution, including comment from Prof. Latif on biomass burning during the southwest monsoon.

title: PEMBAKARAN KECIL BOLEH JEJAS KUALITI UDARA
summary: Laporan di portal berita BERNAMA Radio mengenai pembakaran terbuka berskala kecil dan pengurusan kualiti udara, termasuk peranan sumber rentas sempadan dan tempatan semasa jerebu.

title: SOLAS Southeast Asia Workshop
summary: Recorded regional workshop on air-sea interactions and marine atmospheric science. Professor Latif took part in the closing panel discussion on SOLAS-related research and scientific collaboration in Southeast Asia.

title: Impact of Climate Change on Children: A Malaysian Perspective
summary: Technical report prepared by Universiti Kebangsaan Malaysia with UNICEF Malaysia and Universiti Malaysia Sabah, examining the impacts of climate change and environmental degradation on children in Malaysia and the child-sensitivity of current policies.

title: CEM & AQUAMATE Asia 2026
summary: Head of the scientific committee and keynote speaker, presenting on current understanding and future directions of ground-level air quality measurements in Malaysia.

title: 1st International Conference of Air Quality & Climate Change and 3rd Malaysia Air Quality Annual Symposium
summary: Co-organised the conference and chaired sessions under the theme of combating climate change and improving air quality during a global pandemic.

title: 3rd Conference on Science & Technology Applications in Climate Change (STACLIM 2016)
summary: Keynote presentation at the third STACLIM conference in Kota Kinabalu, Sabah.

title: iCACGP-IGAC Conference 2024
summary: Served on the scientific committee of the joint iCACGP-IGAC conference, which brings together the international atmospheric chemistry research community.

title: Fenomena Jerebu di Asia Tenggara: Punca dan Penyelesaian
summary: Rakaman komunikasi sains awam mengenai punca dan implikasi jerebu di Asia Tenggara.
